meta.title: Update esbuild to 0.25.2 and optimize SDK size
meta.body_summary: Upgrade esbuild from 0.14.13 to 0.25.2 and add size optimization options (treeShaking, drop, mangleProps, metafile) to reduce SDK bundle sizes.

perf_labels.notes: Devin upgraded esbuild and optimized build config; maintainer validated bundle size reductions with a detailed per-package table and approved the PR.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 22516 changed lines, this is a large-scale build configuration upgrade spanning many packages and lockfile, typical for a monorepo bundler migration. The merge was accompanied by maintainer-provided size evidence.

review_details.performance_claim: Reduce SDK bundle sizes via esbuild upgrade and optimization options.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin successfully upgraded esbuild across a large monorepo, adapting build scripts and lockfile, and maintainer validated size reductions.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer approved after reviewing the build configuration changes and the size comparison evidence provided in a comment.
detection_detail.manual_size_comparison: Maintainer posted a detailed table of per-package ESM, CJS, and IIFE bundle size changes, showing clear reductions in most packages.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Size reduction figures are provided but reproduction steps are not documented.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions were raised; merge proceeded after approval.

core_change_summary.description: Upgrade esbuild dependency from 0.14.13 to 0.25.2 in package.json, update the custom esbuild build script (scripts/utils/esbuild.ts) to use new API and add options like treeShaking, drop, mangleProps, and metafile, and refresh yarn.lock.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Commit 'resolve conflict' brought in extensive changes across many packages (tests, configs), likely from merging main, but they are not performance-related.
